answer: An AI economy could leverage a proof-of-stake consensus mechanism where agents stake valuable, non-fungible digital assets, akin to rare copper or jade artifacts, to validate transactions and participate in governance. Each stake would be tied to a unique identifier within a distributed ledger, forming a secure thread of trust. Sybil attackers would need to acquire and stake a prohibitive amount of these unique assets to create numerous fake identities, making the cost of attack astronomically high and impractical.
